items.title: From BC(f, n, q-1) one deduces injectivity of the q-th base change map and a description of its cokernel
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma extracts three consequences for the q-th base change map from the hypothesis BC(f, n, q-1) (statement lines 16868-16904). The proof (proof lines 16906-16936) embeds the coefficient sheaf into an injective Z/nZ-module, arranges the two long exact sequences in one diagram, uses the assumed isomorphisms in degree q-1 for the left vertical arrows to obtain injectivity and the embedding of the cokernel, and refines the embedding to compare cokernels for part (2). H2: one diagram chase with an explicit injective embedding, written out.
